item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Functions support for Node.js 26
item.description:
Azure Functions now supports Node.js 26 in public preview. Developers can test JavaScript and TypeScript function apps on the new runtime while continuing to use the Azure Functions programming model on Linux in Flex Consumption and Elastic Premium plans.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Front Door edge actions
item.description:
Azure Front Door edge actions are now generally available. They let customers run lightweight JavaScript functions during client request and response processing at the edge for real-time request/response handling.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.27.2 improves C++, Go, Rust, and JavaScript analysis
item.description:
CodeQL 2.27.2 is available with a new C++ regular-expression parser and analysis improvements for C++, Go, Rust, and JavaScript. The update applies to the static analysis engine used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub
